newsitem.title: USA: Ross sees full year EPS $3.05-$3.15.
newsitem.headline: Ross sees full year EPS $3.05-$3.15.

text.p: Ross Stores Inc said it expects earnings per share for the year ending February 1 to be in the range of $3.05-$3.15 versus $1.73 for the prior year.
Michael Balmuth, vice-chairman and chief executive, said the results "continue to benefit from broad-based sales gains throughout most geographic markets and merchandise categories."

He said a combination of improved gross profit margins and leverage on expense ratios is expected to contribute to solid expansion in operating margins for both the fourth quarter and the 1996 fiscal year.
The company will release results for the fourth quarter and 1996 fiscal year on March 18.
